# tab-id

Stable per-tab identifier backed by a `web-storage` session store (owner `scope.tab-id`), used to attribute crashes
and notifications to the browser tab that produced them. `getTabId()` lazily
mints a `crypto.randomUUID()` on first call, persists it for the tab's lifetime,
and falls back to `"no-tab-id"` if storage is unavailable.

## Plugin reference

- Description: Stable per-tab id (sessionStorage-backed) for crash/notification attribution, and whether the tab an id names is still open (useTabPresence: every page holds a shared Web Lock under its id).
- Web:
  - Uses: `primitives/dom/web-storage.defineStore`
  - Exports (types): `TabPresence`
  - Exports (values):
    - `getTabId`
    - `useTabPresence`
- Cross-plugin:
  - Imported by:
    - `apps-core/tab-origin`
    - `primitives/live-state`
    - `primitives/scope/app-instance`
    - `reports`
    - `reports/main-thread-stall`
    - `shell/notifications`
